nodes.name: Fortress Gatehouse & Drawbridge
nodes.customNotes: Massive granite gatehouse flanked by stout bastions. The assassin Tarnesh waits upon the stone steps.

nodes.name: The Great Keep Tavern & Common Room
nodes.customNotes: Sprawling three-story taproom warming hundreds of travelers. Bentley Mirrorshade tends bar while Khalid and Jaheira watch the door.

nodes.name: Temple of the Wisdom of Garl
nodes.customNotes: A cheerful stone sanctuary honoring the Glittering Gold gnome deity, offering divine healing.

nodes.name: Joia's Cottage & Stables
nodes.customNotes: A quaint thatched cottage near the outer ramparts where Joia weeps over her stolen Flamedance ring.

nodes.name: Upper Keep Guest Suites (Room 204)
nodes.customNotes: Luxurious private bedchambers where wealthy merchants sleep, containing a chest holding the Golden Pantaloons.
